summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its regaining compliance with Nasdaq's minimum stockholders' equity requirement after receiving a deficiency notice on January 12, 2026. The company completed a registered direct offering of 1,000,000 ADSs at $3.25 per ADS on March 13, 2026, generating net proceeds of approximately $2.96 million, and an at-the-market offering program through A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners, raising approximately $1.8 million from 558,281 ADSs. These transactions resulted in stockholders' equity of approximately $6.48 million, exceeding the $2.5 million threshold. No special situation event is present; this is a routine compliance update.
